meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 渲染动画视频并生成配音
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常做动画短视频，需要批量渲染并加配音。
copy.tagline_en: Render animated videos and generate voiceover
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly make animated short videos and need batch rendering with voiceover.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 驱动 HyperFrames CLI：初始化项目、在目录里搜索并添加现成动效、用 lint/check 做检查、打开预览，经你批准后渲染视频；构建或渲染失败时也会用它诊断。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作或修改动画/视频项目（如搭建、预览、渲染），或要求诊断构建/渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个 HyperFrames 项目，然后打开预览。
先在目录里搜一下有没有“逐行显示标题”的现成动效。
跑一下 check，通过后渲染高清 mp4 给我。
say.note: check 通过并获批后才会渲染，草稿/高清二选一。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI via npx hyperframes: it scaffolds projects, searches/installs motion primitives, runs lint/check, opens previews, renders videos after approval, and diagnoses build/render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit a motion/video project (scaffold, preview, render) or to diagnose build/render failures.

say_en.text: Initialize a HyperFrames project for me, then open the preview.
say_en.note: Runs init then preview and shares the link.

say_en.text: Search the catalog for an existing effect that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Runs catalog --query; if found, adds it.

say_en.text: Run check, then render a high-quality mp4 after it passes.
say_en.note: Check includes lint; render waits for your approval.
